item.title: ‘No harm to Indian farmers’: Union minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan assures agricultural safety in US trade deal
item.description: Shivraj Singh Chouhan said that in the trade deal, no product has been included to harm Indian farmers. He added that no door has been opened to America for India’s main crops, fruits, and dairy production.

item.description: Mardaani 3 hits Rs 31 crore in 9 days, but Sunny Deol’s Border 2 roars to Rs 302 crore net by Day 17. Rani’s cop thriller fights valiantly against the war giant’s dominance—will it recover? Epic box office battle unfolds.

item.description: Sing Dance and Lead book launch at IIT Delhi explored leadership lessons from Srila Prabhupada’s teachings, success and failure through Indian perspectives, spiritual wisdom for modern challenges. This book discovers timeless principles of spirituality for purposeful leading today.

item.title: Russian university stabbing suspect raised neo-Nazi slogans, made blood swastika symbol: Reports
item.description: Visuals shared by local outlets also showed a swastika symbol drawn on a hostel wall, allegedly using a victim’s blood. Authorities have launched a high-level probe into the incident, though they have not officially confirmed the extremist affiliation claims.

item.title: Latest in series of foreign endorsements, Trump backs Japan PM Sanae Takaichi ahead of snap elections
item.description: In addition to Takaichi, Trump has recently also lent support to conservative leaders such as Hungary’s Viktor Orbán and Argentina’s Javier Milei. Be it staunch nationalism, tougher immigration stances or scepticism toward multilateral global institutions that were seen as reasons for support, Trump’s efforts to cultivate a network of ideologically aligned leaders across the globe is now becoming a trend.

item.description: The 14-year-old was adjudged player of the tournament as he cracked 175 from 80 balls in the final against England to guide India to their record-stretching sixth title.
